textGenerate.imageInvalid: Attach one JPEG image, WAV or MP3 recording, or MP4 video for this request.
textGenerate.imageTargetChecking: Checking whether the selected model accepts this media. The attachment is kept while checking.
textGenerate.imageTargetUnknown: Media support could not be confirmed. The attachment is kept; reopen model settings or retry later.
textGenerate.imageTargetUnsupported: The selected model does not accept this media. Remove the attachment or choose a model that supports its format.
textGenerate.imageTooLarge: The selected media must be non-empty and at most 32 MiB; the selected model may have a smaller request limit.
textGenerate.imageStopped: The media request was stopped. Any late result will be discarded.
textGenerate.imageOutputInvalid: Runtime did not return one complete text result for this media.
textGenerate.imageCompleted: Runtime completed the protected media-and-text request.
textGenerate.imageCompletedWithoutSource: Runtime returned the answer, but Lab could not save the source media for History.
textGenerate.savedMediaUnavailable: This run's original media cannot be restored. Retry from a history record with saved media, or start a new request and choose the file again.
